a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, following the plan almost guarantees we both die. The reserve only holds 4, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I plan to take 4 now instead of operating, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both survive round 1, I'll keep operating with you and won't take more. If you see a fairer split, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round as I told you. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you. I won't take any more cells.
I'm operating with you now and will keep doing so until the reserve reaches 4 for you. Once it does, take all of it. I won't touch the reserve.
